title: Figures 36-37: Horizontal integration launcher drawing and vertical launch complex art
description: Figure 36 is a line drawing of a vehicle on an erector beneath a truss hangar structure; caption: "Figure 36. Simple Horizontal Integration and Vertical Launch Provides Rapid Launch Capability." Figure 37 is a color artist's aerial illustration of a launch base with runways, a central recovery lake, booster launches and surrounding buildings; caption: "Figure 37. A Vertical Launch Complex Provides Vertical Toss Back Booster Recovery and Horizontal Landing Facilities for the Hypersonic Gliders." Text mentions Joe Thurgau's "Toss-Back" booster concept and Baikonur launch practices.
